note: Built by data/geo.js. Used only on the phone to turn GPS into a state; the location is never sent or stored.
fixes: Natural Earth v5.1.2 draws Mahe (Puducherry) about 30 km north of the real town (11.70 N, 75.54 E), over Taliparamba in Kerala. Without this fix women around Taliparamba would be offered Puducherry; with it they get Kerala. Mahe itself then shows as Kerala, and she can say No and pick Puducherry from the list.
